rows.note: Use 畀 as the everyday all-purpose verb when a person or authority lets something happen.

example.english: I permit you to use my computer.
example.jyutping: ngo5 bei2 nei5 jung6 ngo5 bou6 din6 nou5

rows.note: Use 可以 when a rule, place, condition, or amount of time makes something allowed or possible rather than someone actively granting it.

example.english: The rules permit pets to enter here.
example.traditional: 呢度嘅規矩可以帶寵物入場。
example.jyutping: ni1 dou6 ge3 kwai1 geoi2 ho2 ji5 daai3 cung2 mat6 jap6 coeng4

rows.note: Use 容許 for an explicit or formal statement that something is allowed or that circumstances make it possible.

example.english: The school's policy does permit students to hold activities on the playground.
example.traditional: 校方嘅政策容許學生喺操場舉行活動。
example.jyutping: haau6 fong1 ge3 zing3 caak3 jung4 heoi2 hok6 saang1 hai2 cou1 coeng4 geoi2 hang4 wut6 dung6

rows.note: Use 批准 when an official body formally approves or authorizes a project, request, or action.

example.english: The board's approval will permit this project to begin.
example.traditional: 董事會批准呢項工程展開。
example.jyutping: dung2 si6 wui6 pai1 zeon2 ni1 hong6 gung1 cing4 zin2 hoi1
